events.summary: Production at the West Qurna 2 field in Basra governorate was halted on 8 December 2025 after a reported leak, according to oil ministry and Basra Oil Company sources.
events.effect: Two sources, one at the oil ministry and one at Basra Oil Company, told Rudaw that production at the field, which was producing roughly 480,000 barrels a day, was halted (Rudaw, 8 December 2025); Attaqa reported the same halt and volume the same day and said the ministry did not answer a request for comment.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 7: production shut in at a reported volume, about 480,000 barrels a day ('تعطّل ضخّ ما يقارب 480 ألف برميل يوميًا').

events.summary: On the afternoon of 11 August 2025 the national grid collapsed during extreme heat: the Ministry of Electricity said the system lost more than 6,000 MW at once under high loads, generating units tripped and the system went into total blackout across the centre and south.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Asharq News and Arabi21: the grid lost more than 6,000 MW suddenly and accidentally, leading to a complete blackout; the ministry said it was working under full emergency footing. Media and local sources reported loss of power in Basra, Maysan, Dhi Qar, Wasit, Baghdad, Diyala, Anbar and Kirkuk.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 5 (grid event; operator emergency and stated scale): the ministry reported "خسارة الشبكة أكثر من 6 آلاف ميغاواط بشكل مفاجئ وعرضي", a total blackout, and that it was working "بحالة الطوارئ الكاملة". No customer count is stated and megawatts are not converted to customers.

events.summary: Fuel supply shortfall: on 23 December 2025 the Ministry of Electricity announced that imported gas had stopped completely, the supplier having cited emergency conditions, and that the system had lost between 4,000 and 4,500 MW of generation.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Attaqa: between 4,000 and 4,500 MW of generation lost; some units stopped and others load-limited; reduced supply hours in a number of governorates (not named). The ministry said it was running affected stations on domestic fuel.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 4 (generation shortfall): dated ministry statement (23 December 2025), stated cause (complete halt of imported gas) and stated size, "ما بين 4 آلاف و4500 ميغاواط من الكهرباء المنتجة".

capacity_affected.source_says: ما بين 4 آلاف و4500 ميغاواط من الكهرباء المنتجة (a range; the lower bound is recorded as the value)

events.summary: National grid collapse: on 4 March 2026 the Ministry of Electricity said the national grid had gone into total blackout in all governorates. As carried by Attaqa, it attributed the blackout to a sudden drop in gas supply to generation, which it called a technical incident, and did not say why the gas supply fell.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Attaqa and Banker: the system blacked out completely across all governorates.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 5 (grid event, stated scale): the ministry said the system "انطفأت بشكل تام في عموم محافظات العراق" (went completely dark across all governorates).
